uutiset.s: The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...

uutiset.t: Arsenal punished for bluntness in attack - but Man City also have problems
uutiset.s: Arsenal face Manchester City in a blockbuster Premier League contest this weekend, but in recent days and months, both teams have issues to overcome.

uutiset.t: 'You question everything' - Haaland lays City's frustrations bare
uutiset.s: Erling Haaland has admitted Manchester City's poor form is affecting the players, admitting "when you don't win, you question everything" after they were held 2-2 at home by Napoli in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Real Madrid top CL table as Bellingham scores stunner in thumping PSV win
Poch cites Eze as he questions Barcola role in Szoboszlai goal - is he right?
uutiset.s: Speaking ahead of his side's clash against Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino questioned Bradley Barcola's impact on Dominik Szoboszlai's freekick goal and made a comparison to Eberechi Eze's disallowed attempt from 2025.

uutiset.t: Wasteful Arsenal held by Borussia Dortmund
uutiset.s: Arsenal were punished for failing to take their chances for the second game in a row as Maximilian Beier clinched a 1-1 draw for Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.

uutiset.t: Parker still winless as Portsmouth beat West Ham
uutiset.s: Scott Parker's winless start to life as West Ham boss continued as Odin Bailey netted his first Portsmouth goal in a 1-0 victory at Fratton Park.

uutiset.t: Lankshear steers Boro back to the top of the Championship
uutiset.s: Will Lankshear was back among the goals as Middlesbrough cemented their position at the top of the Championship with a 2-1 win over Swansea City.

uutiset.t: Aston Villa latest: Emery's blunt response when asked about Garnacho absence
Man Utd latest: Fernandes 'not worried' about future
Villa beaten late on at Galatasaray as winless run continues
uutiset.s: Aston Villa's winless run extended to six games as a late Deniz Gul's header saw them beaten 1-0 by Galatasaray in the Champions League league phase.

uutiset.t: Boro win to go top; West Ham beaten by Portsmouth - EFL highlights
How 'quick check' and unseen angle saw Timber's Isak shirt-pull go unpunished
uutiset.s: Referees’ chief Howard Webb admitted it was a “quick check” by VAR for Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber’s unpunished shirt-pull on Liverpool striker Alexander Isak in the Gunners’ win at Anfield.

uutiset.t: Man Utd to contact PL and refs over 'totally wrong' Yoro red card interpretation
uutiset.s: Manchester United will contact ProRef and the Premier League directly over what they believe to be a 'totally wrong' interpretation of Leny Yoro's red card against Liverpool.

uutiset.t: Rodgers benched by Steelers for game with Broncos
uutiset.s: Aaron Rodgers has been benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers for Friday's game against the Denver Broncos with Mason Rudolph to start in the four-time NFL MVP's place.

uutiset.t: ‘OH NO!’ – George drops player with filthy ankle-breaker!
uutiset.s: Paul George drops Kyshawn George with filthy ankle-breaker before draining jumper!

uutiset.t: Villeneuve: Verstappen showed 'race craft' edge over Mercedes pair in Vegas
uutiset.s: Former Formula 1 world champion Jacques Villeneuve says Max Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix victory showed that Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell will not be able to beat the Red Bull driver in next year's championship unless they have a superior car.

uutiset.t: ‘Just about perfect’ – Hull starts WTGL debut in style
uutiset.s: Charley Hull started her WTGL debut in some style with this brilliant tee shot.

uutiset.t: Hull 'has great laugh' on WTGL debut despite defeat to Woad's Boston
uutiset.s: Charley Hull tasted defeat on WTGL debut as her Atlanta Drive side lost 8-3 to Lottie Woad's Boston Common at the SoFi Center in Florida.

uutiset.t: Hysa aims to win WBC title then take on 'favourite fighter' Fury
uutiset.s: Nelson Hysa has a vision. He wants to dethrone Agit Kabayel, win the WBC heavyweight world title and then take on his favourite fighter – Tyson Fury.

uutiset.s: Hibernian ended their long wait for a Premiership home win after overcoming Dundee 2-1 at Easter Road.

uutiset.t: Norwich hit back to hold QPR
uutiset.s: Norwich's impressive run of victories came to an end as QPR held them to a 1-1 draw at Carrow Road.

uutiset.t: Armstrong nets twice in Wolves win
uutiset.s: Adam Armstrong's brace made it six goals in six games to give dominant Wolves a 3-0 win over Derby in the Sky Bet Championship at Molineux.

uutiset.t: Southampton held at Sheffield United
uutiset.s: Sydie Peck equalised in the 90th minute as Sheffield United came from behind to secure a 1-1 Championship draw with Southampton at Bramall Lane.
